svg.text: Recording storage — what every station shows of archives and imports (DESIGN_Recording_Storage.md §7.3, §8)
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
① The status bar — every station shows the SAME job (the replicated StorageJobs). Its transfer segment sits left of the seat · hat.
archiving while a new Live runs
Archiving exercise 3 — 3 of 4 files · slowed while Live runs
Archive of exercise 2 incomplete — 3 of 4 files (SimHost-1 offline)
the segment is ONE line; a click on it opens ② · ⛔ it never switches mode by itself · a Live never waits for it and is never slowed by it (R-4173):
the transfer gives way while Live runs (the clock mark) and speeds up again after
② Transfers — a click on the status bar's segment (= the orchestrator panel's list)
Transfers — one at a time, the rest wait in order
running · 2 of 4 files · 1.2 / 3.1 GB · asked by this station
queued — after exercise 3 · asked by Debrief-1 (2 stations waiting)
incomplete — 3 of 4 files · SimHost-1 offline; retries when it is back
Cancel / Resume: the Author and Instructor seats (R-4173) —
greyed on another seat: "needs the Author or Instructor seat"
③ ⏏ Close the session — a recorded Live only (AQ108 R2″)
Night attack · exercise 3 — 18:40, recorded on 4 nodes (3.1 GB)
copies in the background — the status bar shows it; the nodes' copies become a cache once verified
not archived — archive later from Open Exercise Recording
deletes the recording on every node — cannot be undone
Archive is the default (R-4171) · an unrecorded Live closes with no question
the all-in-one editor asks the same
④ Opening a run that is only on the NAS — the import (§5a)
Importing Recon · exercise 5 from the NAS
joined the import Debrief-1 started — the same job, the same numbers
waiting: the load starts BY ITSELF when the files are in (the existing loading screen)
in the background: the status bar then offers Open — never by itself
Cancel stops the job for every station that joined it (Author / Instructor seats)
⑤ Open Exercise Recording — where each run is (the replicated inventory)
⛔ "on the nodes" and not archived = the only copy, never removed automatically (§6)
"cached here" = a disposable local copy of an archived run
⑥ Quitting the app while a transfer runs — asked only where the transfer RUNS (the master's host, the all-in-one editor)
Night attack · exercise 3 is still being archived (2 of 4 files).
Quit anyway: nothing is lost — the run stays on the nodes and the archive resumes at the next start.
another station (an instructor's, a debrief station) quits with NO question —
the transfer runs on the master, not on it; the job stays in every status bar.
an import cancelled by a quit leaves no partial file (.part is deleted);
the NAS is never touched by an import.
